author: RAFAEL MELO REIS
purpose: Convert exact dimensionless geometry relations into diagnostic features that may adapt numerical resolution, synthetic fixture density and routing priority without adapting physical/cosmological parameters.

operations: multiplication: radii multiply and phases add
division: radii divide and phases subtract
kth roots: radius^(1/k), phase branches (theta+2pi m)/k

adaptive_policy.reason: Geometry resemblance or a dimensionless invariant is not a physical mechanism and must not become a post-hoc fitted cosmological parameter.

RLL G0/G6 already provide a legitimate diagnostic/projection context
adaptive use can be restricted to numerical and routing decisions
F_gap: no validated mapping from these features to RLL physical parameters
no observational likelihood improvement attributable to this adapter
no independent provider CI receipt yet
F_next: run deterministic tests; then predeclare one synthetic hidden-truth experiment and one observational residual feature before any G5 handoff
